items.quote: championed public communications on the new scheme and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
spearheaded the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics at the national level.
took ownership of work with three sister agencies on a shared problem and steered it to completion.
was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading.
contributed effectively to making the permit forms easier for the public to fill in.
set the direction for community engagement on the estate renewal plan across the public service.
led adoption of new technology tools for case officers across the department.
headed incident management during the ransomware attack, setting priorities for several teams.
drove the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined for the whole division.
